import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n;
    static final int N = 15;
    static char[][] field = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] capsule = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] Z = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] S = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int t;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static boolean in(int i, int j) {
        return i>=0 && i<n && j>=0 && j<n;
    }

    static boolean isDigit(char ch) {
        return ch>='1' && ch<='9';
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        static final int MAXN = 210;
        static final int MAXE = 111111;

        int[] l = new int[MAXN];
        int tot;
        int[] cur = new int[MAXN];
        int[] d = new int[MAXN];
        int u, v, src, sink;
        Edge[] E = new Edge[MAXE];

        class Edge {
            int v, x, cap;
            Edge(int v, int x, int cap) {
                this.v = v;
                this.x = x;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        void add(int u, int v, int cap) {
            E[tot] = new Edge(v, l[u], cap);
            l[u] = tot++;
            E[tot] = new Edge(u, l[v], 0);
            l[v] = tot++;
        }

        void init() {
            Arrays.fill(l, -1);
            tot = 0;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            System.arraycopy(l, 0, cur, 0, MAXN);
            d[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.add(src);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                u = Q.poll();
                for (int i = l[u]; i != -1; i = E[i].x) {
                    v = E[i].v;
                    if (d[v] == -1 && E[i].cap > 0) {
                        d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                        Q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[sink] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int in) {
            if (u == sink) return in;
            int flow = 0, f;
            int i = cur[u];
            while (i != -1) {
                int next = E[i].x;
                v = E[i].v;
                if (d[v] == d[u] + 1 && E[i].cap > 0) {
                    f = dfs(v, Math.min(in - flow, E[i].cap));
                    if (f > 0) {
                        flow += f;
                        E[i].cap -= f;
                        E[i^1].cap += f;
                        if (flow == in) break;
                    }
                }
                cur[u] = next;
                i = next;
            }
            if (flow < in) d[u] = -1;
            return flow;
        }

        int dinic(int _src, int _sink) {
            src = _src;
            sink = _sink;
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                flow += dfs(src, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static MaxFlow F = new MaxFlow();

    static void bfs(int x, int y, int[][] d, boolean f) {
        int sx = x, sy = y;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(d[i], INF);
        d[x][y] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(x);
        Q.add(y);
        if (f && isDigit(capsule[x][y])) {
            F.add(sx*n+sy, sx*n+sy+n*n, INF);
        }
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            x = Q.poll();
            y = Q.poll();
            if (d[x][y] == t) break;
            for (int o = 0; o < 4; o++) {
                int xx = x + dx[o];
                int yy = y + dy[o];
                if (in(xx, yy) && d[xx][yy] == INF && capsule[xx][yy] != 'Y') {
                    if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || (Z[xx][yy] == d[x][y] + 1 && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy]))) {
                        d[xx][yy] = d[x][y] + 1;
                        if (f && isDigit(capsule[xx][yy])) {
                            F.add(sx*n+sy, xx*n+yy+n*n, INF);
                        }
                        if (Z[xx][yy] > d[x][y] + 1 || !f) {
                            Q.add(xx);
                            Q.add(yy);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        int src = n*n*2;
        int sink = src + 1;
        F.init();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    // store zombie position (not used further, but we need to know)
                    // Actually we need to compute Z distances from that position, done later
                }
            }
        }
        // Actually we need to find the first Z, but the code uses a single Z? In original, they assign x,y to the last Z found (but there should be only one). We'll find it.
        int zx = 0, zy = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (field[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zx = i; zy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            capsule[i] = sc.next().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(capsule[i][j])) {
                    F.add(i*n+j+n*n, sink, capsule[i][j]-'0');
                }
            }
        }
        // BFS from zombie position to compute Z distances
        bfs(zx, zy, Z, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (isDigit(field[i][j])) {
                    F.add(src, i*n+j, field[i][j]-'0');
                    bfs(i, j, S, true);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(F.dinic(src, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
